explanation: Baseline failure: TypeError at line 269 because `_actions` was called with three positional arguments (state, types, links) but its signature only accepted two (state, types). The fix removes the broken `_LINK_CACHE`/`_compute_links` indirection (which relied on data not actually passed in) and threads the link relation through `_actions` as a proper argument extracted from `init` via a new `_read_links` helper. Also corrected the `carry` effect of `pickup_spanner` to also drop any stale `at` fact for the man already present (well, here the man stays at the location — but the action only affects the spanner's `at` and adds `carrying`; that's already correct per the PDDL). Trivial cleanup of `_subtypes` to drop a `if False else None` no-op. Public contract (`get_plan(objects, init, goal)`) preserved. n_params remains 0.
